devon: quick heads-up — profiler from the canary shows a p95 spike (~120ms) on the /chat/compose route after the kernel handoff when microbatches are very small (<=3). suspect KV cache churn + kernel selection overhead. snippet below.

maria: :eyes: do we have traces to correlate kernel_switch_count with kv hit ratio? last month we saw churn when prefix diversity > 0.6.

aj: ran a local sim with microbatch=4 and reproduced ~25ms kernel swap penalty. if kernel_preference is cost-weighted we cut that to ~10ms.

devon: profiler excerpt (5s window):
```
route=compose | p95=120ms | kernel_select_ms=28 | kv_lookup_ms=45 | kernel_switch_count=3 | avg_batch_size=2.6
route=compose-short | p95=40ms | kernel_select_ms=8  | kv_lookup_ms=10 | kernel_switch_count=0 | avg_batch_size=6.1
```

maria: interesting that compose-short has larger batches — maybe traffic shape explains it. we should try steering token budgets by route/tier so small-request routes get a slightly higher per-request token budget to avoid frequent kernel swaps.

aj: here's a quick config prototype for the token mapper + kernel hinting:
```yaml
route_token_map:
  "/chat/compose":
    token_budget: 1200  # bump for tiny batches
    kernel_hint: prefer_low_overhead
  "/chat/compose-short":
    token_budget: 512
    kernel_hint: prefer_throughput
default:
  token_budget: 768
  kernel_hint: auto
```

sam: can you post the PromQL you used so I can add panels to the dashboard and a canary gate? want to track kernel_switch_count, kv_hit_ratio, and p95.

devon: promql for kv miss rate (5m):
`rate(kv_cache_miss_total{route="/chat/compose"}[5m])`
for kernel switches: `increase(kernel_switch_total{route="/chat/compose"}[5m])`
for p95: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{route="/chat/compose"}[5m])) by (le))`

deploy-bot: canary deploying token-mapper:v2 -> 5% traffic to dedicated pool (job id: canary-7712).

maria: propose experiment arms: 1) token_budget caps for low-tier routes (as aj config) 2) kernel_hint override for seq_len<128 to prefer low-overhead kernels 3) extend queue_window by +20ms for mixed-route queues. telemetry gates: p95, kv_hit_ratio, kernel_switch_count, avg_batch_size.

aj: +1. also add kernel_switch_count per 10k requests as a synthetic metric. i'll add it to infra agent.

devon: plan: roll token-mapper:v2 -> canary 5% for 2h. revert if p95 for any route in the canary group increases > baseline + 15ms or kv_hit_ratio drops > 5pp. I'll post results.

sam: i'll prep dashboard and a perf-runbook steps for rollback.

maria: nice. if the canary is clean, we should follow with a gradual rollout but keep kernel_preference telemetry live (30d retention) so we can spot drift. :thumbsup:

devon: thanks all — starting the canary now. will ping in 30m with first snapshot. :rocket:
